question:
Have the following BigQuery request which is perfectly working on the BigQuery console :

DECLARE dynamic_sql STRING; SET dynamic_sql = ( SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CONCAT(' MAX(CASE WHEN field_name = "', field_name, '" THEN field_value END) AS ', REGEXP_REPLACE(field_name, '[^a-zA-Z0-9_]', '_')), ', ') FROM jira.all_latest_fields );

SET dynamic_sql = CONCAT('SELECT issue_id, ', dynamic_sql, '` FROM jira.all_latest_fields GROUP BY issue_id');

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE dynamic_sql;

I need to implement this one in dbt, I have the following request but it's not working :

{{ config(materialized='table') }}

{% set dynamic_sql_query %} SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CONCAT('MAX(CASE WHEN field_name = "', field_name, '" THEN field_value END) AS ', REGEXP_REPLACE(field_name, '[^a-zA-Z0-9_]', '_')), ', ') AS sql_columns FROM {{ ref('jira_all_latest_fields') }} {% endset %}

{% set dynamic_query %} SELECT issue_id, {{ (adapter.query(dynamic_sql_query)).rows[0].sql_columns }} FROM {{ ref('jira_all_latest_fields') }} GROUP BY issue_id {% endset %}

{% do adapter.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {{ this }}") %}

{% do adapter.execute("CREATE TABLE {{ this }} AS (" ~ dynamic_query ~ ")") %}

Got the following error : 09:18:12 Compilation Error in model jira_custops (models/jira_custops.sql) 09:18:12 'dbt.context.providers.RuntimeDatabaseWrapper object' has no attribute 'query'. This can happen when calling a macro that does not exist. Check for typos and/or install package dependencies with "dbt deps".

I have tried with ChatGPT without success
title: dbt and BigQuery : dynamic SQL
answer:
The error is very straightforward, the object adapter has no method query.

I think you want the run_query macro. Also, since you're using materialized=table, you don't need to create the table manually:

{{ config(materialized='table') }}

{% set dynamic_sql_query %} 
SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CONCAT('MAX(CASE WHEN field_name = "', field_name, '" THEN field_value END) AS ', REGEXP_REPLACE(field_name, '[^a-zA-Z0-9_]', '_')), ', ') AS sql_columns FROM {{ ref('jira_all_latest_fields') }} 
{% endset %}

{% set dynamic_columns = run_query(dynamic_sql_query).rows[0].sql_columns %}

SELECT issue_id, {{ dynamic_columns }} 
FROM {{ ref('jira_all_latest_fields') }} GROUP BY issue_id
